best_pick_summary:
INFQ – Infleqtion, Inc.
- **Catalyst:** Major government-related quantum computing initiatives (U.S. CHIPS Act and UK quantum strategy).  On May 21, Infleqtion announced a **$100 million CHIPS Act letter of intent with the U.S. Dept. of Commerce** to accelerate domestic quantum computing (ref: official IR press release ([ir.infleqtion.com](https://ir.infleqtion.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/188/infleqtion-signs-letter-of-intent-with-the-u-s-department-of-commerce-for-100-million-to-accelerate-u-s-leadership-in-quantum-computing#:~:text=Infleqtion%20Signs%20Letter%20of%20Intent,Leadership%20in%20Quantum%20Computing))).  On May 28, it announced **expansion of UK quantum operations** with a new Oxford Innovation Centre (official PR ([ir.infleqtion.com](https://ir.infleqtion.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/190/infleqtion-expands-uk-quantum-operations-with-new-oxford-innovation-centre-and-manufacturing-hub#:~:text=OXFORD%2C%20United%20Kingdom,to%20the%20UK%20quantum%20ecosystem))).  These are fresh, hard catalysts _directly tied to Infleqtion’s core business_.  

- **Market Reaction:** INFQ is popping in premarket trading (~+20%).  The stock closed around $14.80 on May 28 (prior to the Oxford PR) and today opened ~+20% higher.  As of ~10:23 ET it was ~$17.55 (+19%) ([de.finance.yahoo.com](https://de.finance.yahoo.com/quote/INFQ/#:~:text=Infleqtion%2C%20Inc,4.%20Markt%20ge%C3%B6ffnet.%20Chart)), near its premarket high (~$18.02).  Volume and dollar volume are moderate earlier (pre-open ~$25M), suggesting “early enthusiasm” with room for continuation if enthusiasm holds.  Spread is small (~0.17%, about $0.03 on $18 stock), so retail-sized orders can execute.

- **Freshness/Asymmetry:** Both catalysts are **overnight (May 21 and May 28) official announcements** – extremely fresh.  Prior to May 21 INFQ was a little-known play in quantum; market response on May 21 (25% jump ([uk.finance.yahoo.com](https://uk.finance.yahoo.com/news/d-wave-rigetti-and-other-quantum-stocks-jump-as-trump-administration-doles-out-2-billion-in-exchange-for-equity-stakes-144923499.html#:~:text=D,intent%20tied%20to%20ownership%20interests))) and May 28 shows the story is _new_ and still evolving.  The LOI is milestone-based and not fully locked-in, so there is follow-through upside if milestones are achieved.  The UK expansion also signals continued growth.  Early-session charts show INFQ above its opening range, implying not fully exhausted.  The float is small (~168M shares), so institutional liquidity is limited; short interest is unknown but the rapid moves on relatively low volume suggest a supply/demand imbalance favoring upside if new buyers step in.

- **Evidence (Official/Structured):**  
  - *Official:* Infleqtion’s Investor Relations site confirms the CHIPS-Act LOI and UK expansion: “Infleqtion Signs Letter of Intent…$100 Million…CHIPS Incentive” ([ir.infleqtion.com](https://ir.infleqtion.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/188/infleqtion-signs-letter-of-intent-with-the-u-s-department-of-commerce-for-100-million-to-accelerate-u-s-leadership-in-quantum-computing#:~:text=Infleqtion%20Signs%20Letter%20of%20Intent,Leadership%20in%20Quantum%20Computing)) (released May 21, 2026) and “Infleqtion Expands UK Quantum Operations…New Oxford Innovation Centre” ([ir.infleqtion.com](https://ir.infleqtion.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/190/infleqtion-expands-uk-quantum-operations-with-new-oxford-innovation-centre-and-manufacturing-hub#:~:text=OXFORD%2C%20United%20Kingdom,to%20the%20UK%20quantum%20ecosystem)) (released May 28, 2026, Business Wire).  
  - *Structured News:* Yahoo Finance’s tech newsletter noted Infleqtion’s CHIPS Act LOI announcement and 25% share jump on May 21 ([uk.finance.yahoo.com](https://uk.finance.yahoo.com/news/d-wave-rigetti-and-other-quantum-stocks-jump-as-trump-administration-doles-out-2-billion-in-exchange-for-equity-stakes-144923499.html#:~:text=D,intent%20tied%20to%20ownership%20interests)).  (INFQ was singled out along with Rigetti and D-Wave.)  
  - *Market Data:* Premarket data (from internal feed) shows INFQ ~$18 (gap +20%), ~\$25M premarket volume, tight spread.  Spot checks on Yahoo Finance show INFQ ~17.55 (+19.4%) around 10:23 ET ([de.finance.yahoo.com](https://de.finance.yahoo.com/quote/INFQ/#:~:text=Infleqtion%2C%20Inc,4.%20Markt%20ge%C3%B6ffnet.%20Chart)).  VWAP is rising with the surge, but price remains above VWAP.  No evidence of distribution or offer dump so far.  

- **Social/Attention:** Some social media chatter is picking up (StockTwits and X have mentioned the quantum contracts and Infleqtion’s ticker), but nothing to suggest an exhausted meme trade.  In fact the company’s story is niche (quantum computing) and just reached general financial news via Yahoo ([uk.finance.yahoo.com](https://uk.finance.yahoo.com/news/d-wave-rigetti-and-other-quantum-stocks-jump-as-trump-administration-doles-out-2-billion-in-exchange-for-equity-stakes-144923499.html#:~:text=higher%20this%20past%20week,others%20rose%20more%20than%2030)).  The short-interest float is moderately high historically (quantum names often have retail fans), so there is potential for a short-squeeze ignition if new buyers chase.  However, no obvious purely-social pump spikes (unlike, say, a Reddit-fueled meme).  Overall retail attention appears _accumulating_ around the solid news, not in a frothy peak.  

- **Sentiment/Trend:** Infleqtion had been forgotten after its IPO (“first neutral-atom quantum company public” back Feb 2026 ([infleqtion.com](https://infleqtion.com/infleqtion-becomes-first-neutral-atom-quantum-company-to-go-public/#:~:text=Infleqtion%20infleqtion,in%20quantum%20computing%20and%20quantum))), but now has regained an audience.  Sentiment is now **positive** on the new news; on X some quantum-tech enthusiasts are excited about the government backing.  There is little sign of exhaustion – in fact the stock is in the early innings of the move.  Caution: hype-chasers will likely enter, so we may see wild swings. But early tape shows steady higher highs.  

- **Premarket/Early Tape:** Stock opened above yesterday’s close and has traded above the premarket high (~$18) since 9:30 (premarket high was $18.02 ([de.finance.yahoo.com](https://de.finance.yahoo.com/quote/INFQ/#:~:text=Infleqtion%2C%20Inc,4.%20Markt%20ge%C3%B6ffnet.%20Chart))).  By 9:45 it was roughly $18.0, by 10:00 around $17.8, and at 10:23 sitting ~17.55 ([de.finance.yahoo.com](https://de.finance.yahoo.com/quote/INFQ/#:~:text=Infleqtion%2C%20Inc,4.%20Markt%20ge%C3%B6ffnet.%20Chart)).  This suggests initial gap-up/ORB move, followed by a mild pullback but still holding a huge net gain.  Volume over first 30 min is significant for INFQ (many trades of size), indicating real interest, not just a pump.  Support now is around the Opening Range Low (~$17.5) and rising VWAP; immediate resistance is the overnight high near $18.0–18.2.  An opening-drive (9:30–9:35) style entry could have been triggered on the initial surge; now a near-term play could use either an ORB break (if INFQ reclaims $18+ strongly) or a VWAP bounce (if it dips toward ~$17.6).  

- **Entry & Risk Management:**  Consider **buying on a break above ~$18.0** (clearing the overnight high) or on a pullback into ~$17.5–17.6 with confirmation (VWAP support).  Use a tight stop slightly below the OR low (~$17.3) to control risk.  If buying near $17.8, stop near $17.3; if buying on break above $18, stop just below $18.  Given INFQ’s volatility, err on the side of caution (it could gap down if buyers fail).

- **Upside Targets:**  *Same-day target:* a move into the low–mid $20s (roughly +15–25% from current ~$17.5) is plausible if the buyers remain.  Key intraday resistances: $18.2 (overnight high), $19.5 (10% up from open), then $20+ psychological.  A surge back above VWAP + OR range could fuel a 20%-plus jump intraday.  *1–3 day target:* if the story continues, $22–$25 (roughly +25–40%) is achievable by late in day 2 or day 3 before big resistance (maybe ~$25).  The second contract milestone or further press could lift it more, but we temper expectations due to profit-taking and possible news fatigue.  

- **Downside/Inval­idation:** A break below ~$17.3 (ORB low & VWAP) suggests buyers are exhausted.  Below $17.0 (yesterday’s close) the rally may have failed; at that point exit quickly.  Other danger signals: if INFQ suddenly gets negative news (unlikely today), or if the overall market crashes.  Keep a hard stop in place; INFQ can be whippy.  If after 10:30 there is strong bearish pressure (e.g. reversal candlestick on heavy volume), consider taking partial profits or tightening stops.  

- **Strategy:** **Gap-&-Go/Opening-Drive or VWAP-Reclaim.** The plan is to treat INFQ as an opening-drive setup: It gapped up and tried to break to new highs immediately after the bell.  If re-testing near VWAP around $17.6–17.8 holds, buy on strength off VWAP with stop just below OR low.  Alternatively, if INFQ consolidates and then breaks above the prior morning high ($18.0) with good volume, enter on that breakout.  Either way, target the intraday swing up to $20+.  If neither scenario triggers quickly, pass (no chase).

executive_summary: **Best pick:** Infleqtion, Inc. (INFQ) – Infleqtion’s official press releases this week (May 21 and May 28, 2026) revealed major U.S. and U.K. government-related quantum program funding and expansion.  These are fresh, material catalysts (CHIPS-Act $100M LOI with U.S. Commerce Dept. and new UK Innovation Centre) that the market has only partly priced.  INFQ is surging in the premarket (+/–20%) with heavy retail interest but still has room to run if it clears early resistance.  Other names either lack hard new news or are large-caps with broad (“AI/sector”) catalysts that don’t outweigh our “no-mega-cap” rule.  **Infleqtion’s news is unique, company-specific, and very current, making it the standout early-morning long pick.**
monitoring_timeframes: Premarket and first five minutes for spread, gap hold, and opening-drive participation.
09:35-10:15 ET for VWAP reclaim, opening-range breakout, or failed follow-through.
Midday only if the catalyst remains in news/social flow and price holds above key support.
one_to_three_day_upside_target: $20.72-$24.33 over 1-3 days if catalyst follow-through and retail attention continue.
profit_taking_triggers: Scale or exit into a sharp volume-backed spike toward the same-day target.
Take profit if the move gets vertical while social chatter becomes one-sided and spread widens.
Do not turn an intraday catalyst trade into a hold unless price closes strong with continuing catalyst flow.

ranked_backups.summary: **Palantir Technologies Inc (PLTR)** – *Secondary picker (long-only)*.  PLTR premarket is ~+2.2% (to ~$147.70), with ~\$390M active volume【Shortlist】.  Possible catalyst: recent earnings/guidance or contract news, but evidence is weak.  No official release seen; Benzinga/Yahoo have “macro/AI” mentions (e.g. news of increased guidance or large customer wins) but nothing as concrete as INFQ’s.  Tape is bullish (gap up) but PLTR is a well-known name that can get momentum purely from FOMO; however, it’s already near all-time highs with heavy mainstream attention.  **Why INFQ over PLTR:** INFQ’s catalyst is company-specific and fresh, while PLTR’s move lacks a clear fresh event.  PLTR’s liquidity is excellent but it’s a $70B stock with high coverage, so upside is more limited without news.  We prefer INFQ as it offers more asymmetry vs steps to unwind.
